risks: The writable packet has no server handler, IPC/generated client registration, export/search writer, actual editor caller or locale ownership. End-to-end dual ACL and agent extraction cannot be truthfully delivered by a TSX component and pure helper alone. Additional seam discovery requires a revised reviewed packet, not extra unleased edits.

NotesViewHost is not the Markdown editor host; merely adding an optional callback/prop there does not wire Doc embed insertion or Sessions. Do not create a second surface to hide this missing caller seam.

bindSurfaceContext copies the entire supplied revision map; visibleContextEntityRefs removes IDs only, not revision metadata or extracted body. rebaseLiveContext retains entityRefs and replaces revisions without policy checks. Every extraction/rebase must first prune selected permitted refs, fields, bodies and revisions at authenticated authority.

sameContextSnapshot does not compare snapshotPolicy, block selection or authorization/query epoch. Do not use it alone to prove range/policy equality; preserve helper semantics and perform full package binding checks separately.

Resource registry source proves fan-out and sorting only. A provider that returns hidden titles/data leaks them through the merge unless its real query/owner enforces policy. No registry rewrite is authorized in this packet.

Legacy and official Markdown engines use different parsing/serialization hooks. Legacy html:false and currency/math preprocessing can lose or modify structured embed tokens without an accepted retained-reference codec; unknown versions must not be normalized away.
Native Task rows must keep canonical IDs and owner commands; Notes projections currently count Markdown checkboxes. No dataset copy, parallel done field or recalculation fork is permitted.

Snapshot pinning does not grant indefinite cached read after revoke. Live rebase cannot enlarge selected context silently; remote-private offline access requires accepted bounded lease policy and fails closed otherwise.

Published RS-BASE-01 proposes a CustomRecord entity kind while the later Lark entity model uses existing page kind plus additive contentKind/aliases. Published RS-DOC-01 collaborative_document and Lark document descriptors also need accepted mapping. Consume approved foundation descriptors, do not pick a new kind by string replacement in this package.
